response.justification: The candidate lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience and 5 years of large-scale infrastructure/cloud compute platform experience; their work is primarily in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang with minimal evidence of cloud compute leadership or distributed systems architecture at scale, and they have no documented technical leadership mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers.
strengths: Strong full-stack versatility across languages and domains
Proven open-source contributions and technical mentoring through workshops
Experience with distributed systems and high-throughput services (e.g., microservices at Dunnhumby)
concerns: Only 1–2 years of C++ experience (NI LabWindows), far below 8-year requirement
No demonstrable cloud compute platform ownership or architecture experience
Lacks formal technical leadership roles mentoring cloud or infrastructure teams
